_readme: The B3 hard gate's owner registry (host-resolution linter, followups T5, 2026-09-09). Every static z assignment in registry/files must clear ONE of four exits: (1) var-keyed z — dynamic by design, skipped; (2) z=0 — the relative-z-0 rooting idiom IS the proof; (3) the page-terminal calibrated plane — the whitelisted values below in the whitelisted files; (4) a HOSTS entry whose evidence needle exists in the evidence file at gate time. The registry is bidirectionally asserted: a hosts entry with zero census sites is STALE (fail — the owner was deleted, prune the seed); a census site whose file has no exit is UNREGISTERED (fail — root the ladder or annotate its category, then seed it). Evidence needles are stable substrings (isolation declarations, rooting idioms, category annotations), so a refactor that drops the proof fails the gate even when the seed survives. Seeded from the stacking-isolation archive's three-category table + the input-color-isolation round.
